key_insight: Among three tested D-gun spray distances, 190 mm produced Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 with the lowest porosity and best corrosion resistance in 1 M H₂SO₄.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray distance can improve coating integrity and corrosion protection for DSS 2205 components exposed to acidic environments.
method: D-gun spray Cr₃C₂–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Examine coating morphology and porosity using SEM.
Evaluate corrosion at room temperature using OCP, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, and potentiodynamic polarization.
evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm; the 190 mm coating showed a corrosion rate of 0.113 mm/year versus 2.60 mm/year for uncoated DSS 2205.
watch_item: The reported optimum applies to the tested distances and room-temperature acid conditions; long-term service durability and performance outside these conditions remain unverified.
paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
